unlockWhy: Without the password you can neither seal a question nor open answers.
closedHint: The form stays on the page but accepts no new entries.
noArea: The form has no area of its own — the questions go under the key of the answer area. Set the form's area in the “Settings” tab.
personOnly: entered and corrected only by the person
lockedTitle: It cannot be deleted while the requirement is ticked — you can move it and change its text.
lockedDelete: Belongs to the requirement “{need}” — untick it first.
question: Question
takenOff: “{label}” was taken off the form — nobody will get it any more, and the answers so far stay in the entries. It can be restored below.
takenOffList: Taken off the form ({count}) — their answers stay in the entries
designNoArea: Layout and logic are sealed with the key of the form's area — set it first in the “Settings” tab.
designNoPassword: Without the password the layout can be neither read nor sealed.
designLocked: This form has a saved layout, but you do not have the key it was sealed with — it can be neither read nor overwritten.
designNoQuestions: Questions first — layout and logic build on them.
noQuestionsNoEntries: Questions first — without them there are no entries.
tidyDone: Phone numbers and addresses are already stored in one form.
tidyFound: {list} stored differently from the rest of the database.
tidyHint: Numbers as +48 600 700 800, addresses as in the register (street and number, town, postcode and post office). Those marked “check” could not be recognised for sure — they are unticked.

msg.noPasswordOpen: Without the password in this tab the answers cannot be opened.
msg.noneSent: There are entries, but the service did not release their content: no question of this form belongs to an area you read. Ask for access to the area the answers go to.
msg.noneOpened: {count} sealed answers arrived and none opened. This intake key does not fit these envelopes. Usually it means the entries were made under another key pair of this area or under an earlier version of the page — such entries cannot be recovered, they must be collected again.
msg.shutAreas: You do not have the intake key of area {list} — its answers stay closed.
msg.restNoMatch: The rest does not fit these keys.
msg.noPasswordFix: Without the password nothing can be corrected.
msg.checksExpired: Confirmations of corrected numbers have expired — it is a different way of writing the number now.
msg.noPasswordSeal: Without the password the question cannot be sealed.
msg.resealUnread: Not every question can be read now — without that they cannot be resealed.
msg.resealDesign: The form's layout cannot be read now — without that it cannot be resealed.
msg.needsArea: The form needs its own area first.
msg.designSealed: The saved layout is sealed with a key you do not have.
msg.unread: Not every question can be read now.
msg.resealingForm: Resealing the questions with the form's key…
msg.hiddenQuestions: The questions area “{area}” is not public — on the page the questions can be read only by whoever reads this area (signed in or through an access link); for everyone else they will be unreadable. Should it be for everyone? In that area, in the tab “For everyone”, set “Everyone reads” — or choose a public area here.
msg.hiddenForm: The form area “{area}” is not public — on the page the questions can be read only by whoever reads this area (signed in or through an access link); for everyone else they will be unreadable. Should it be for everyone? In that area, in the tab “For everyone”, set “Everyone reads” — or choose a public area here.

stale.one: One question is sealed with the key of another area ({areas}) than the form's questions area — it is unreadable on the public page.
stale.other: {count} questions are sealed with the key of another area ({areas}) than the form's questions area — they are unreadable on the public page.

msg.staleUnread: Not all of them can be read now — the key of that area is needed.
msg.noQuestionsKey: You do not have the key of the questions area.
msg.reseal: Reseal with the questions area key
msg.noPasswordMove: Without the password the answers cannot be moved.
msg.noPerson: The account does not run any person yet.
msg.noPasswordSave: Without the password nothing can be saved.

blind.one: One person will not see the corrected answers in their link — there is no key to their place here.
blind.other: {count} people will not see the corrected answers in their link — there is no key to their place here.

people.newTitle: Entries that arrived since you last looked
people.smsToDone: SMS to {number} — already opened in this round
people.tagUnopenedTitle: The link waits for someone to open it the first time and answer the question
people.extNoKey: You cannot open this extension with this key.
people.byOffice: A person added by the coordinator — they have no link of their own.
people.noSeat: This entry came without a place — there is no link that could be sent.
people.removeAsk: Delete the entry: {name}? The answers will be erased with no way back — not even by whoever runs the service.
people.hideHint: “Hide” only hides the row. Deleting takes away the entry, not the person's access.
people.smsOpened: Opened the link sent by SMS — {date}
people.notReleased: The service did not release the content of this entry — you do not read the area it went to.
people.noneFits: {count} sealed answers, none fits this intake key.
people.noQuestions: The questions did not load — below are the answers alone.

subject.openFailed: Could not open this form's entries.
subject.signIn: {what} are visible only to the form's coordinators — sign in.
subject.noPassword: Without the password in this tab the entries cannot be opened ({what}).
subject.noForm: This page chooses a person from a form, but no form was given.
subject.empty: Nobody is in this form yet.
subject.noMatchChosen: Nobody matches this filter — {name} is outside it.
subject.listPage: Page with the list of people (optional)
subject.listHint: Where “← list” leads when someone opens this page directly. Whoever came from the list (module “List of people”) goes back where they came from — with the same filter.
subject.kindUse: At the top of the page a choice of one person who filled in the form (◀ ▶ through the list, filter); the modules “Person panel” show everything about them. For coordinators.
subject.keyForm: id of the module “Form” — whose entries can be chosen
subject.keyList: optional: path of the page with the module “List of people” — where “← list” leads

table.csvHint: The CSV file contains decrypted answers — on this computer nothing protects them any more.
table.editHint: Change answers in the cells and save. Columns of questions taken off the form cannot be changed. Changing a phone number clears its confirmation.
table.editHintAdd: Change answers in the cells or add new people, and save. Columns of questions taken off the form cannot be changed. Changing a phone number clears its confirmation.
table.personOnlyTitle: Only the person themselves enters and corrects this answer

sms.textPlaceholder: Write a message or choose a ready one…
sms.holesHint: {link} — the person's page (made automatically), {imie} — first name only, {osoba} — first name and surname. What cannot be filled in stays visible in braces.
sms.holesHintVerify: {link} — the person's page (made automatically), {imie} — first name only, {osoba} — first name and surname, {verify} — a link confirming this number. What cannot be filled in stays visible in braces.
sms.leaks: The message contains {list} — the link asks for that when first opened. Whoever gets the SMS by mistake will read the answer together with the question. Remove it from the text.

withoutSeat.one: 1 person has no place — for them {link} stays in braces.
withoutSeat.other: {count} people have no place — for them {link} stays in braces.

willRenew.one: 1 person will get a new link when sending. Their previous link will stop working.
willRenew.other: {count} people will get a new link when sending. Their previous link will stop working.

willRenewAsks.one: 1 person will get a new link when sending, which will ask for: {list} when first opened. Their previous link will stop working.
willRenewAsks.other: {count} people will get a new link when sending, which will ask for: {list} when first opened. Their previous link will stop working.

sms.name: Template name

list.title: Forms
list.groupHint: A group is a folder — nothing changes for those filling in.
list.removeGroupAsk: Delete the group “{name}”? The forms stay — just without a group.
list.emptyGroup: Empty group — move a form here from its “⋯” menu.
list.none: You have no form yet. The easiest way: on the workshop page “What do you want to do?” → “Sign-ups for an event”.
